source.customer_pn_rule: Strip SJ vendor prefix. List as Skyjack + OEM number.
source.fitment_rule: Flyer models are typical applications. Store as vendor-featured. Do not overwrite existing compatible_models. Do not show as Verified fitment until a second source confirms.

accuracy_notes: SJ/SJIII 3219 means both the SJ and SJIII 3219 series — expand to two keys.
SJ/SJIII 6826 and SJ6832 RT are different machines. Never collapse compact 6826/6832 into SJRT.
Existing RT-QRG listings use SJRT ####. Flyer RT tokens (SJ6826 RT) canonicalize to SJRT #### and merge additively.
OCR garbage (SJ/SJIIISJIII, SJ/SJII on a row that starts SJ/SJIII) is flagged and must be visually confirmed before publish.
PDP copy currently says Verified fitment — flyer lists must not go into compatible_models until that copy is split.
